trigger.plain: After a pullback into the broken Creek or value-area high, an hourly close above the prior day's high on volume

decisions.reason: TREND: W and D swing HH/HL, D 0.5% under the last swing high, but W 4.1% above the last swing high and far from value. Do not chase (C3, C15); wait for the test, then a sign-of-strength bar (C7, C12).

trigger.plain: At the test of the broken Creek, an hourly close above the prior day's high on volume

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close below structure_shift_ref and vwap_14d, back into the old range
decisions.reason: Back-up to the broken Creek, the preferred entry (C7): D 1.7% above the last swing high, W and D swing HH/HL. Last bar red, D below EMA9, H1 at 2% of the day's range: the trigger must print, buy stop above its high (C12).

trigger.plain: After a pullback into the broken Creek or value-area high, an hourly close above the prior day's high on volume

decisions.reason: TREND: W swing HH/HL, 20.9% above the last swing high: away from value. D swing HH but LL and H1 LH/LL: the corrective wave is under way. Wait for the test, then a sign-of-strength bar (C3, C7, C12).
